{"title":"Admin: Ingest Health","description":"Actual fetcher run telemetry from the HEC ingest-log mirror (index=wearables_log)","defaults":{"dataSources":{"ds.search":{"options":{"queryParameters":{"latest":"$global_time.latest$","earliest":"$global_time.earliest$"}}}},"visualizations":{"global":{"showProgressBar":true}}},"inputs":{"input_global_trp":{"type":"input.timerange","options":{"token":"global_time","defaultValue":"-24h,now"},"title":"Time Range"}},"dataSources":{"ds_heldback":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest msg="run complete"
| eval dr=events/targets
| stats sum(dr) as delivered sum(skipped) as held_back by comp
| eval delivered=round(delivered), total=delivered+held_back
| eval pct_held=round(held_back/total*100,1)
| sort - pct_held
| rename comp as Vendor delivered as "Delivered (new)" held_back as "Held back" pct_held as "% held back"
| table Vendor "Delivered (new)" "Held back" "% held back""},"name":"Held back vs delivered"},"ds_kpi_runs":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Runs (24h)","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (msg="run complete" OR msg="run failed")
| stats count"}},"ds_kpi_failed":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Failed runs","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest msg="run failed"
| stats count as c
| eval color=if(c>0,"#E8503A","#4CAF50")"}},"ds_kpi_errors":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Errors (24h)","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest level=ERROR
| stats count as c
| eval color=if(c>0,"#E8503A","#4CAF50")"}},"ds_kpi_events":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Events delivered (24h)","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest msg="sent events"
| stats sum(count) as e
| fillnull e"}},"ds_users_attention":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Users needing attention","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (msg="run complete" OR msg="run failed")
| stats latest(_time) as last latest(msg) as outcome latest(detail) as detail latest(error) as errtype by person_id comp
| where outcome="run failed"
| lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT person_name
| eval Person=if(isnull(person_id) OR person_id="","(run-level / admin)", coalesce(person_name,person_id)." (".person_id.")")
| eval Since=strftime(last,"%m-%d %H:%M")
| sort Person comp
| table Person comp errtype detail Since
| rename comp as "Data source" errtype as Error detail as "What needs fixing" Since as "Failing since"
| appendpipe [ stats count as _c | where _c=0 | eval Person="", "Data source"="", Error="", "What needs fixing"="All feeds healthy - no users need attention", "Failing since"="" | table Person "Data source" Error "What needs fixing" "Failing since" ]"}},"ds_feedstatus":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Feed status","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (msg="run complete" OR msg="run failed")
| stats latest(_time) as last latest(msg) as outcome latest(duration_s) as dur latest(events) as events latest(skipped) as skipped by comp
| eval age_min=round((now()-last)/60,1)
| eval Status=case(outcome="run failed","FAILED", age_min>180,"STALE", true(),"OK")
| eval last=strftime(last,"%m-%d %H:%M")
| sort comp
| rename comp as Feed last as "Last run" age_min as "Age (min)" dur as "Dur (s)" events as Events skipped as Skipped
| table Feed Status "Last run" "Age (min)" "Dur (s)" Events Skipped"}},"ds_recentruns":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Recent runs","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (msg="run started" OR msg="run complete" OR msg="run failed")
| sort - _time
| head 50
| eval Time=strftime(_time,"%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| table Time comp level msg events skipped duration_s detail
| rename comp as Feed level as Level msg as Event events as Events skipped as Skipped duration_s as "Dur (s)" detail as Detail"}},"ds_errors":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Errors & warnings","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (level=ERROR OR level=WARN)
| sort - _time
| head 50
| lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT person_name
| eval Time=strftime(_time,"%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), Person=if(isnull(person_id) OR person_id="","(run-level)",coalesce(person_name,person_id)." (".person_id.")")
| table Time comp Person level msg detail error file
| rename comp as Feed level as Level msg as Event detail as Detail error as Error file as File
| appendpipe [ stats count as _c | where _c=0 | eval Time="", Feed="", Person="", Level="", Event="No errors or warnings in range", Detail="", Error="", File="" | table Time Feed Person Level Event Detail Error File ]"}},"ds_throughput":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Events delivered / hour","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest msg="sent events"
| timechart span=1h sum(count) as events by comp"}},"ds_duration":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Run duration (s)","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest msg="run complete"
| timechart span=1h avg(duration_s) as dur by comp"}},"ds_coverage":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Coverage by person & source","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest (msg="run started" OR msg="run complete")
| stats count as log_runs latest(_time) as log_last latest(fetcher_ver) as fetcher_ver latest(run_host) as run_host by person_id comp
| append [ search `widx` | stats count as data_events latest(_time) as data_last by person_id vendor | rename vendor as comp ]
| append [ search `widx` earliest=-30d | stats latest(_time) as roster_last by person_id vendor | rename vendor as comp ]
| stats sum(log_runs) as log_runs max(log_last) as log_last sum(data_events) as data_events max(data_last) as data_last max(roster_last) as roster_last values(fetcher_ver) as fetcher_ver values(run_host) as run_host by person_id comp
| fillnull log_runs data_events value=0
| lookup wearable_person_profile person_id OUTPUT person_name
| eval Person=coalesce(person_name,person_id)
| eval Signal=case(data_events>0,"OK",log_runs>0,"quiet (ran, 0 new)",true(),"SILENT (no data)")
| eval last=coalesce(data_last,log_last,roster_last)
| eval "Last heard"=if(isnull(last),"-",strftime(last,"%m-%d %H:%M"))
| eval rank=case(Signal LIKE "SILENT%",0,Signal LIKE "quiet%",1,true(),2)
| sort rank Person comp
| table Person person_id comp Signal data_events log_runs run_host fetcher_ver "Last heard"
| rename comp as Source data_events as "Data events" log_runs as Runs run_host as Host fetcher_ver as Version"}}},"visualizations":{"heldback_tbl":{"type":"splunk.table","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_heldback"},"options":{"backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.5)","drilldown":"none","columnFormat":{"Vendor":{"align":"left"},"Delivered (new)":{"align":"left"},"Held back":{"align":"left"},"% held back":{"align":"left"}}},"title":"Dedup — held back vs delivered by vendor (per-record)"},"heldback_note_md":{"type":"splunk.markdown","options":{"markdown":"### Why "held back" is high — and why that's healthy
Fetchers don't just pull "since the last run." Each run **re-pulls a rolling window of the last few days** (Oura/Withings 2d, Garmin 3d, Google 7d; Apple re-reads its export folder) and the **dedup store suppresses anything already delivered** — so a high **% held back** is the overlap safety-net working, not wasted work.

**Why the overlap is needed — late & backdated data.** Example: an **Oura sleep** that begins before midnight is timestamped **yesterday**, but Oura finalizes and publishes it **this morning** after you wake and sync. A checkpoint of "an hour ago" would query from today onward and **miss it** — the record is dated yesterday but only appeared in the API today. Re-pulling the last few days catches those late/revised records; dedup then drops the duplicates so nothing double-counts.","backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.5)"}},"kpi_runs":{"type":"splunk.singlevalue","title":"Runs (24h)","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_kpi_runs"},"options":{"majorValue":"> primary |
